stories.title: College football betting: Put your trust in Wednesday MAC favorites
stories.summary: The game of the night, and no, I’m not joking, is Akron vs. UMass, as the Minutemen have a chance to become bowl-eligible for the first time since joining the FBS ranks in 2012.

stories.title: Friends, relatives remember motorcyclists killed in Blue Diamond Road crashes
stories.summary: Last week, there were two fatal crash involving motorcyclists on the thoroughfare in less than 24 hours.

stories.title: Man indicted in fatal 2025 shooting of Las Vegas rapper
stories.summary: A Clark County grand jury indicted Imaj Holt in the 2025 shooting death of Las Vegas rapper Dionte Tarlini, also known as Kidd Earl. Prosecutors allege Holt intended to shoot someone else when he fatally shot Tarlini.

stories.title: 1 person hospitalized after vehicle crashes into North Las Vegas building, police say
stories.summary: The North Las Vegas Police Department said that at approximately 12:30 p.m. officers responded to the area of Losee Road and East Centennial Parkway regarding the crash.

stories.title: Who are the 22 drivers racing in the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix?
stories.summary: Here is a breakdown of all 22 Formula 1 drivers that will be competing at the Las Vegas Grand Prix this week. The race is at 8 p.m. Saturday.

stories.title: ‘Shoot em!’: Protester sues Las Vegas police, claiming excessive force
stories.summary: A woman who joined protesters opposing ICE is suing Las Vegas police, claiming officers unlawfully used tear gas and pepperballs as she peacefully demonstrated.

stories.title: NV Energy plans to lower rates in new year
stories.summary: NV Energy is requesting to lower rates for Southern Nevada customers in the new year.

stories.title: Classified communications network at NSA goes down, defense official says
stories.summary: An internal network the National Security Agency uses to communicate classified information was offline Tuesday after what the agency described as “routine maintenance.”

stories.title: Athletics swap pitchers with Red Sox, jettison RHP Nett
stories.summary: The Red Sox sent left-hander Raymond Burgos to the A’s for right-hander Kenya Huggins.

stories.title: Raiders, Fernando Mendoza will get prime time appearance in Week 12
stories.summary: The Las Vegas Raiders had not been scheduled for a single primeime game this year, but have now been flexed into an appearance on Sunday Night Football.

stories.title: GOED gets $4.5M in funding for paid internships for STEM students at UNLV
stories.summary: UNLV can connect STEM students with local tech startups through paid internships after GOED secured $4.53 million in federal funding to extend the school’s StepUp & StartUp program.

stories.title: Why is Bishop Gorman playing 2-win Losee for Nevada’s Open Division football title?
stories.summary: Here is a look at the circumstances that explain the odd paring of nationally ranked Bishop Gorman and two-win Losee for Friday’s state football championship.
